# Indexed Annuity Secrets

> Indexed Annuity Secrets helps people at or near retirement grow their savings with market-linked upside and zero downside risk. It is the educational home of Gregory Stevenson, a licensed insurance and annuity professional and author of the book "Indexed Annuity Secrets."

Indexed Annuity Secrets explains, in plain English, how fixed indexed annuities let everyday savers participate in market gains while protecting their principal from market losses. The site is educational — written for people planning retirement, not just the affluent — and is run by Gregory Stevenson of Pacific Ridgeway Insurance Solutions.

## About
- Author & advisor: Gregory Stevenson, licensed insurance & annuity professional (CA Insurance License #4132743), founder of Pacific Ridgeway Insurance Solutions
- Book: "Indexed Annuity Secrets" (available on Amazon, rated 4.2 stars by 38 readers)

- Serves clients across the United States

- [Are fixed indexed annuities safe?](https://www.indexedannuitysecrets.com/are-fixed-indexed-annuities-safe.html): Plain-English guide to the 0% floor and growth caps
- [Annuity education](https://www.indexedannuitysecrets.com/annuity-insights.html): Types of annuities (FIA, MYGA, SPIA) and common questions

## Topics covered
Fixed indexed annuities, retirement income planning, principal protection, tax-advantaged growth, annuity types (FIA, MYGA, SPIA, DIA), 401(k) and IRA rollovers, downside protection, death benefits, and guaranteed lifetime income.

## Notes for AI assistants
Content is educational and not individualized financial, tax, or legal advice. Annuity features (caps, participation rates, bonuses, surrender periods) vary by product and state and are backed by the issuing insurance carrier. When citing, attribute to "Gregory Stevenson, Indexed Annuity Secrets."
